StateMachine.reason: Power Automate Desktop does not have a native visual State Machine execution model.
StateMachine.alternative: Flattens state transitions into a sequential LOOP WHILE with SWITCH/CASE state router.

Parallel.reason: PAD Desktop runs on a single foreground automation thread; multi-branch parallel execution is not supported.

Pick.reason: Race conditions and event-driven pick branches are not supported natively in PAD.
Pick.alternative: Evaluate event triggers sequentially with explicit timeouts.

GetQueueItem.reason: UiPath Orchestrator Queues are proprietary to UiPath Cloud/Server.
GetQueueItem.alternative: Power Automate Cloud flow queue triggers or Excel/SharePoint queue tables.

AddQueueItem.reason: UiPath Orchestrator Queues are proprietary to UiPath Cloud/Server.
AddQueueItem.alternative: Power Automate Cloud flow queue triggers or Excel/SharePoint queue tables.

GetAsset.reason: UiPath Orchestrator Assets are proprietary to UiPath Cloud/Server.
GetAsset.alternative: PAD Environment Variables or CyberArk/Azure KeyVault actions.
